selectOrNew: Select a form or create a new one.

field.name: Name
field.label: Label
field.formatDerived: Format {{format}} inherited from type {{tipo}} — declared only once.
field.formatConflict: Conflict: the declared format ({{declarado}}) disagrees with the one derived from the masked type ({{derivado}}). Publishing will be refused.
field.catalogUnavailable: Catalog unavailable — the list is empty because the read failed, not because there are no formats.

dimensions.title: Instruments
dimensions.empty: No instruments — questions record standalone metrics.

blocks.title: Blocks
blocks.empty: No blocks — add an instrument or a dialog block.

archive.hint: Removes it from the catalog and from new bindings. Anything already using this form keeps working.
archive.purgeHint: This form was never published — deleting it is permanent.
archive.readOnly: Archived form: restore it before editing.
archive.banner: Form archived on {{at}}. It no longer appears in the catalog and cannot be bound to anything new, but it is still served to whatever already references it — until that deployment is changed.
archive.confirm:
Archive "{{id}}"?

It leaves the catalog and new bindings. Anything that already references it (deployments, live contacts, history) keeps working. You can restore it later.
archive.confirmPurge:
Permanently DELETE "{{id}}"?

This form was never published, so nothing can be using it — which is why it will be really deleted, with every version. There is NO way to restore it.

err.instrumentType: Every instrument block needs a type (CSAT/NPS/…) or a custom key.
err.askWhenRef: The "only ask if" guard references "{{field}}", which is not a prior question.

form.empty: No fields declared — this question collects nothing. Open the JSON and declare `fields[]`.
form.inert: In this interaction the runtime ignores: {{keys}}. The values stay in the document — edit them in the JSON.

json.title: Form JSON
json.applyAnywayHint: The checker rejected it. Applying only changes the draft — nothing is saved.
json.applyHint: Apply only swaps the draft; saving is still Save/Publish.
json.drift: Applied, but the block projection rewrote: {{nodes}}.

err.notObject: The JSON must be a form object.
err.formIdLocked: form_id cannot change on an existing form (expected: {{id}}).

verdict.unavailableDetail: The checker did not answer ({{reason}}). This is NOT "no errors" — it is "not verified".
verdict.okDetail: Structure is valid. Does not cover the format x mask conflict (D8), which is checked on publish.

preview.disclaimer: This is the `render` block the runner receives — not a channel mockup. Each channel draws it its own way.
preview.unavailable: The preview appears once the JSON is valid.
